post.description: Create an account, sign in, and email a link to confirm the address.

get.description: Whether a username is free, for the signup form (no account yet, so by IP).

post.description: End the current session. Succeeds even if not signed in.

delete.description: Permanently delete the account and every video and analysis in it.

post.description:
Confirm an address from the emailed link. Works without signing in, since the
link may be opened on another device.
Email a fresh confirmation link. Earlier links stop working.

Email a reset link if the address has an account. The response is the same
either way, so it can't be used to find out who has an account.
Set a new password from the emailed link. Signs out every device, this one included.

Change the password from Settings. This device stays signed in; every other one is
signed out, and any reset link stops working.

Email a confirmation link to the new address. The account keeps its current
address until the link is opened.

Switch to the new address from the emailed link, and tell the old address.
Works without signing in, like confirming an email.

get.description: Download everything stored about the account, as one JSON file.

patch.description: Change the fields sent; leave the rest as they are.

get.description: Whether a username could be yours, for checking as it's typed.

put.description: A new profile picture: a square JPEG of up to 1 MB, as the browser prepares it.

post.description:
Post one of your finished serves. Its skeleton video, thumbnail and scores are copied
into the post; the note and filename aren't.

patch.description: Change your post's caption or who can see it.

delete.description: Delete your post, with its likes, comments and stored video.

get.description: Someone's posts that you can see, newest first.

Public: everyone's public posts. Friends: posts (public and friends-only) from your
friends. Newest first, a page at a time; ``cursor`` is the last page's next_cursor.

put.description: Like a post. Liking again changes nothing.

get.description: Oldest first; pass ``cursor`` (the last page's next_cursor) for newer ones.

delete.description: Delete your comment, or any comment on your post.

get.description: Someone's page: what they show you, and where the two of you stand.

How many friends, followers and following you have. The lists are paged, from
/people/{your username}/{friends|followers|following}.

Someone's friends, followers or following, newest first. Only they and their friends
(people they follow who follow them back) can see these.

put.description: Follow someone (or follow them back). Doing it again changes nothing.

delete.description:
Stop following someone; if you were friends, you aren't any more. Already not
following is fine.
Remove someone from your followers (they aren't told). Ends a friendship too.

get.description:
You and your friends who chose to be on it, ranked by the average of each one's latest
serves in the window. Too few serves in the window means not ranked yet.

post.description: Block someone. Neither of you follows the other any more, and they can't find you.

get.description: Your conversations with messages in them, newest first.

post.description: Open your conversation with a friend, making it the first time.

get.description: Unread messages across all your conversations, for the navigation's badge.
Newest first; pass ``before`` (the last page's ``next_cursor``) for older ones.

delete.description: Delete one of your messages for everyone. It shows as "Message deleted".

post.description:
Report someone, or one of their messages to you, for the operator to review. A copy of
the message is kept with the report, so deleting it doesn't remove the evidence.
Mark them all read (done when you open the list).
Create a record and return a presigned URL to PUT the video to.

get.description: History, newest first, optionally filtered. Score filters only match scored analyses.

delete.description:
Delete an analysis with its video and results, whatever its status.

If a worker is processing it, the worker finds the job gone and stops: its
status writes no longer match a row, and anything it publishes is removed.

post.description: Queue the analysis once the upload has finished.

put.description: Add, change or (with an empty note) remove your own note on an analysis.
Tell us this result looks wrong. Sending another replaces the previous report.

get.description: The report sent about this analysis, or null.

schema.title: Response Get Report Analyses  Analysis Id  Report Get

get.description:
Per-frame landmarks and metric series.

Served straight from the pipeline's frames.json (validated against
FramesPayload in tests) to avoid re-parsing a large payload per request.

ChangeEmailRequest.title: ChangeEmailRequest
ChangeEmailRequest.description: The current password too, so a borrowed or stolen session can't take over the account.

DataExport.title: DataExport
DataExport.description: Everything stored about an account, as given by "Download my data".

DeleteAccountRequest.title: DeleteAccountRequest
DeleteAccountRequest.description: The current password, so a borrowed or stolen session can't delete the account.

EditPost.title: EditPost
EditPost.description: Only the fields sent change; an empty caption removes it.

FollowPage.title: FollowPage
FollowPage.description:
A page of someone's friends, followers or following, newest first. ``you_follow`` and
``follows_you`` are about you, the viewer.

KeyScore.title: KeyScore
KeyScore.description: One key position's score, for History's cards (serve_analyzer.score).

LandmarkTrack.title: LandmarkTrack
LandmarkTrack.description: Normalised coordinates (0-1 of the frame), one entry per frame; null when missing.

MeasurementConfidence.title: MeasurementConfidence
MeasurementConfidence.description: How far one measurement can be trusted (serve_analyzer.confidence).

NoteRequest.title: NoteRequest
NoteRequest.description: The person's own note on an analysis; empty or null clears it.

Person.title: Person
Person.description: Someone's page, as you see it.

PersonSummary.title: PersonSummary
PersonSummary.description: What anyone who can see you is shown: never an email or anything private.

Post.title: Post
Post.description: A serve someone posted, as you see it.

ProfileUpdate.title: ProfileUpdate
ProfileUpdate.description:
Only the fields sent are changed. An empty display name or bio removes it; a username,
once chosen, can be changed but not removed.

SendMessage.title: SendMessage
SendMessage.description: Text, a serve (one of your finished analyses), or both.

SharedServe.title: SharedServe
SharedServe.description: A serve sent in a message.
